gate_definitions.name: walk-forward / pre-game information only
gate_definitions.why: Every input to the bet decision is known before kick-off and, for the model rules, comes from a fit that used only earlier games.

gate_definitions.name: observed prices on every scored bet
gate_definitions.why: Every scored bet carries a price taken from the source file. No -110 assumption is used.

gate_definitions.name: at least 200 scored bets
gate_definitions.why: Below this, a run of luck is indistinguishable from skill at any plausible effect size.

gate_definitions.name: hit rate beats the break-even implied by the actual prices taken
gate_definitions.why: Break-even is computed from the real price on each bet, not from 0.5.

gate_definitions.name: survives multiple testing (BH-adjusted p < 0.05, 12 rules tested)
gate_definitions.why: Testing many rules and reporting only the best one manufactures winners; the Benjamini-Hochberg step charges for that.

gate_definitions.name: positive in a untouched holdout (2024 + 2025)
gate_definitions.why: The holdout seasons were never used to tune the rule thresholds.

gate_definitions.name: positive in at least 60% of individual seasons
gate_definitions.why: An edge that exists in only one season is a season, not a strategy.

gate_definitions.name: 95% bootstrap confidence interval on ROI excludes zero
gate_definitions.why: Ten thousand resamples of the actual bet log; the interval must sit above zero.

leaderboard.strategy: S07 Fade the road favourite of 7+
S12 Out-count gap of 3 or more
S08 Home team off a bye
S10 Over when the total is 50 or higher
S09 Under when the total is 40 or lower

price_source: Observed prices taken from the source file for every scored bet. Games without a price are not scored and are counted below.

luck_accounting.method: Null: the observed prices are fair, so a 1-unit bet at decimal d has mean profit 0 and variance d-1. The standard deviation of total profit is then sqrt(sum(d_i - 1)) over the bets actually placed. No simulation and no assumption beyond independence of bets.
luck_accounting.note: The last column is the number of bets the strategy would need before an edge of the observed size could be detected 80% of the time at the 5% level. Where that number is larger than any realistic season, the honest answer is that the sample cannot settle the question.
